jvm_x86_retained_nonqualifying_failure.cause: The initial independent fixture compared unspecified CDR alignment padding as message data; the callback stopped and the guest timed out with errno 11.
jvm_x86_retained_nonqualifying_failure.correction: Enumerate native metadata alignment padding; require every field byte, complete callback canonical bytes and original deserializer equality. SDK, launcher and Wasm bytes remain unchanged.

jvm_cross_architecture_fixture_scope.original_text: ROS1 uses the same complete fixture values on both architectures. The frozen ARM ROS2 fixture and this native x86 ROS2 fixture use different deterministic full values; each guest is checked against its own original native callback.

retained_harness_limitations: The initial cgroup pseudo-file read and unsupported json.save API preflights stopped before any configuration command.

The first baseline matrix retained 48 valid JVM configurations but stopped at a separate control whose top-level assert is unavailable in the Xmake DSL. The corrected isolated scope matrix passes all eight cases.

Refusal snapshots observe real engine-created targets using an otherwise-empty public in-memory before-load hook. The original provider load callback remains intact and must still reject. Earlier hidden-private-API and sandbox-pcall attempts are retained as failed diagnostic setup only.
The existing Unitree provider rejects unsupported WASI platforms with its existing memory64-oriented diagnostic; this patch changes example selection only.
Other language examples and their generators are delegated separately; these results qualify only the twelve JVM declarations.
